diff --git a/tests/notifier/notifiers/test_repair_slack_webhook_post.py b/tests/notifier/notifiers/test_repair_slack_webhook_post.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/notifier/notifiers/test_repair_slack_webhook_post.py
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+import unittest
+from mock import patch
+
+from google.cloud.forseti.notifier.notifiers import slack_webhook
+
+
+class SlackWebhookSendTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_send_uses_notification_config_webhook_url(self):
+        url = 'https://hooks.slack.com/services/T000/B000/X000'
+        with patch.object(slack_webhook.SlackWebhook, '__init__', lambda self: None), \
+                patch.object(slack_webhook.requests, 'post') as mock_post:
+            notifier = slack_webhook.SlackWebhook()
+            notifier.notification_config = {'webhook_url': url}
+            notifier._send(payload='violation-payload')
+            mock_post.assert_called_once_with(url, json={'text': 'violation-payload'})

(
bash /testbed/mimo_test_command.sh
)
REPAIR_RC=$?
cd /testbed || exit 1
if [ -x /opt/test_venv/bin/python3 ]; then
  PATH=/opt/test_venv/bin:$PATH
  export PATH
  python() { /opt/test_venv/bin/python3 "$@"; }
  python3() { /opt/test_venv/bin/python3 "$@"; }
fi
/root/.pyenv/shims/python -m pytest tests/notifier/notifiers/test_repair_slack_webhook_post.py -v
REPAIR_NEW_RC=$?
if [ "$REPAIR_NEW_RC" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
exit "$REPAIR_RC"
